subject: Auriga Health — aligning purchasing workflow and cost owner
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shastri <priya@aurigahealth.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@aurigahealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Auriga Health — aligning purchasing workflow and cost owner

Hi Priya / Michael —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and a few clear asks to keep momentum: 

Summary (2-min):
- You’re piloting Redwood to reduce model inference cost for clinical summarization; expected scope: 6-8 models, peak concurrency ~30 req/s.
- Primary success criteria: 30–40% per-token cost reduction without exceeding 150ms 95th-percentile latency for short summaries.

Open items / asks:
1) Can you confirm the financial approver who owns budget sign-off? (Name + email) — we need the person to loop in for pricing & contract cadence.
2) Who owns procurement and legal reviews? We can prep a one-page procurement packet and a short SOC2 summary to accelerate.
3) Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call (technical + procurement) this week to agree on MAP (mutual action plan) and timeline.

Attached: draft mutual action plan (MAP) stub for review — Auriga_MA_plan_v1.pdf

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 11/23 10:00–10:30
- Tue 11/23 15:00–15:30
- Wed 11/24 09:00–09:30

If you prefer, we can also send a short procurement package first.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Auriga_MA_plan_v1.pdf (1 page — draft MAP)

From: Priya Shastri <priya@aurigahealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@aurigahealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Auriga Health — aligning purchasing workflow and cost owner

Thanks, Ava — great summary. Quick answers: 

- The budget owner is our CFO, Rita Balan (rita.balan@aurigahealth.com). She handles approvals for SaaS/vendor spend > $50k.
- Procurement is handled by procurement@aurigahealth.com (cc’ing here). Legal review typically comes from Samir Khan (samir.khan@aurigahealth.com) in-house counsel.
- Michael (cc’d) is our lead for the pilot and will handle technical acceptance criteria.

I’ll review the MAP with Rita and procurement — we should be able to confirm a time after they’re looped in. For procurement, please include a short security artifact (SOC2 snapshot) and a concise SOW statement of work in the packet.

Priya
Head of Digital Programs | Auriga Health
priya@aurigahealth.com
